activities.title: Meet someone new
activities.prompt: We've just met at a friend's gathering. What's something you've been spending time on lately?

activities.title: Explain an interest
activities.prompt: Pick something you know or enjoy. Explain it to me as someone completely new to it.

activities.title: Respond to someone
activities.prompt: I joined a new team a month ago. Everyone's friendly, but I still feel outside the group. Yesterday I had an idea and didn't say anything.

activities.title: Make a case
activities.prompt: Suggest an activity we could do together this weekend and try to get me interested.

activities.title: Tell a story
activities.prompt: Tell me about a time something didn't go as planned. It can be funny, ordinary, or meaningful.
